'''Aluna''' is a female [[NPC]] found in [[Startorch Academy - Square]] in front of an elevator with her classmate, '''Linda'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Linda:''' Eh?! Deer, Eluna!{{sic}}
:'''Aluna:''' Huh? What's wrong?
:'''Linda:''' No, I mean a literal deer! The mech reindeer!
:'''Linda:''' Remember last time? Your sister [[Zahira]] rode a mech reindeer over the Royan Market wall to deliver your lunch... and got caught?
:'''Aluna:''' Yeah... she's on the Academy's "system blacklist" now.
:'''Linda:''' But they missed the reindeer! It's back, this time carrying a whole pack of Gravlaks from the Royan Market!
:'''Linda:''' It probably couldn't find you. Look at it, munching on landscaping shrubs over there. Won't budge. You'd better get over there...
:'''Aluna:''' Oh, no... I'm on it! Cover for me with the teacher, will you? And mark my attendance!

----
;Outside the dorm, a professor talking with a security
:;So you banned Zahira from campus, but not her mech reindeer?
:;What's to stop it from eating the lawn? Raiding the kitchen? Or, I don't know, giving a freshman a heart attack?
{{Dialogue End}}
